champions.tldr: Damage health ratio increased to 4–12% of target's maximum health from 4–10%|health.; Bonus movement speed increased to 60–100 (3 ranks)% from 50–80 (3 ranks)%.

champions.name: Neeko
champions.tldr: New Innate: While within 300 units of a non-epic monster, minion, trap, ward, pet, or plant, Neeko stores their Sho'Ma over 2 seconds. Only one of these units can be stored at a time and she can clear out the Sho'Ma o…
champions.gameplayImpact: Neeko was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Innate: While within 300 units of a non-epic monster, minion, trap, ward, pet, or plant, Neeko stores their Sho'Ma over 2 seconds. Only one of these units can be stored at a time and she can clear out the Sho'Ma of the current unit to change the disguise to a different one. Afterwards, she can transform into that unit by selecting them in the interface.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Removed: Disguise no longer breaks upon taking damage.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Disguise now also breaks upon the form taking lethal damage or when Neeko becomes immobilize or deals damage to a structure while in the form of a non-champion.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Removed: Disguise no longer modifies her attack speed or movement speed if the unit's values are higher than hers.

lines.label: Cooldown
lines.note: Cooldown reduced to 2 seconds at all levels from 25–10 (lv 1–16).

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Undocumented / Removed: Indirect damage is no longer exempt from triggering the cooldown.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Jungle companion now properly becomes invisible while she is disguised as an allied champion.

lines.label: Bloom base damage
lines.note: Bloom base damage reduced to 35–135 from 40–140.

lines.label: Bloom AP ratio
lines.note: Bloom AP ratio increased to 25% AP from 20% AP.

lines.label: Effect radius
lines.note: Effect radius increased to 250 from 225.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Now deals 30–70 bonus damage against monsters per bloom.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Casting the ability beyond its maximum range will now cast the ability at maximum range instead of having her walk into position to throw it.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Can now recast the ability in order to send her clone to the target location.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Clone now plays her Blooming Burst}}, Tangle-Barbs}}, dance, joke, taunt, laugh, and animations and their respective sound effects.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: On-hit now deals 50 bonus damage against monsters.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Clone now spawns directly on top of her, instead of 100 units in front of her.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Now properly copies certain debuff effects.
